'''Playtesting''' is a [[GEMP]] format that adds GEMP's Playtesting set to the [[Open]] card pool. Only GEMP administrator and playtester accounts can see it.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /><ref name="hall" />

* '''Type:''' casual
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee GEMP
* '''Card pool:''' the Open pool plus the Playtesting set (GEMP set id 501)
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''Playtesting'' (<code>playtesting</code>) on both the Players Committee GEMP and play.swccg.com

== Card pool ==
The format allows Decipher set ids 1&ndash;14 ([[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]), premium ids 101&ndash;112, current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;27 (ids 200&ndash;227) and the Virtual Premium Set (id 301), plus the Playtesting set (id 501). Its definition sets the <code>playtesting</code> flag.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /> The definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

The public GEMP code reserves 300 card numbers for the Playtesting set but has no card files for it; the cards being tested are not in the public code.<ref name="cardcounts" />

== Rules on GEMP ==
* The game hall, the format rules page and deck validation show the format only to administrator and playtester accounts.<ref name="hall" />
* In a Playtesting game, every Defensive Shield in the Playtesting set for the player's side is added to the cards outside that player's deck.<ref name="swccggame" />
* A player (not a bot) may use a special action on the top card of their Reserve Deck to upload a card.<ref name="gameconditions" />

== History ==
The format is in the Players Committee GEMP code and in play.swccg.com, which descends from a copy of it, with the same definition.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="pc-gemp" /> No source gives when it was added or who uses it. No tournament is known to have used it.
